title: MPESB PNST 2026 Answer Key
vacancyDetails: Model answer key / response sheet for MP Pre-Nursing Selection Test admissions
qualification: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology as per PNST eligibility
selectionProcess: PNST Entrance Exam → Merit / Counselling for nursing admissions
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials for login, photo ID for record
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open PNST 2026 Answer Key / Model Answer / Objection link
3. Login with Application No. and DOB
4. Download response sheet and key
5. Raise objections till ~17 July 2026 if window open
shortDescription: MPESB PNST Answer Key 2026 released on 15 July for exam on 10 July 2026. Objection till about 17 July at esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
MPESB has released the PNST 2026 Answer Key on 15 July 2026 for the Pre-Nursing Selection Test held on 10 July 2026.

Candidates can download model answers and response sheets from esb.mp.gov.in and raise objections within the short window (about 15–17 July 2026).
